L16: ## 30.19 Higher direct images of coherent sheaves
L17: 
L18: In this section we prove the fundamental fact that the higher direct images of a coherent sheaf under a proper morphism are coherent.
L19: 
L20: reference
L21: 
L22: 【11†Proposition 30.19.1.】 Let $S$ be a locally Noetherian scheme. Let $f : X \to S$ be a proper morphism. Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a coherent $\mathcal{O}_ X$-module. Then $R^ if_*\mathcal{F}$ is a coherent $\mathcal{O}_ S$-module for all $i \geq 0$.
